files.script_format_guide.txt:
PROFESSIONAL SCREENPLAY FORMAT GUIDE

• Use Courier 12pt font throughout
• Scene headings: INT./EXT. LOCATION - TIME
• Character names centered and CAPS
• Dialogue justified left, indented
• Action lines in present tense
• Parentheticals sparingly used
• Page margins: 1" top/bottom, 1.5" left, 1" right
• One page = approximately one minute screen time
files.chemistry_lab_inventory.txt:
STANDARD UNIVERSITY CHEMISTRY LAB INVENTORY

Common Chemicals:
- Hydrochloric acid (HCl)
- Sulfuric acid (H2SO4) 
- Sodium hydroxide (NaOH)
- Ammonia (NH3)
- Acetone
- Ethanol
- Methanol
- Phenol
- Various metal salts
- Organic solvents

Equipment:
- Fume hoods
- Bunsen burners
- Glassware (beakers, flasks, pipettes)
- pH meters
- Balances
- Heating mantles
- Safety equipment (eyewash, shower)
